title: observability: token-level metrics/tracing, dashboards and alert tuning for cost/latency breakdowns
author: Ava Patel
description:
Motivation: provide token-level cost and latency observability to make per-route and per-model unit economics transparent and to reduce alert noise by tuning thresholds to token-aware distributions. This PR adds token-level metrics, histogram-based latency bucketing, improved trace sampling and tagging, Grafana dashboards for token cost/latency breakdowns, and updated alert rules to reduce false positives.

Summary of changes: implemented a token metrics collector (Prometheus histograms and counters) instrumented in the serving runtime; added tracing middleware to include token counts and model_variant metadata; shipping new Grafana dashboards and panels (cost-by-token, p50/p95/p99 token-latency heatmaps, KV-cache hit correlation); tuned alert rules to target tail latency per-token rather than raw per-request thresholds; added unit and integration tests + a small migration script to backfill histogram buckets for recent data.

Checklist: - [x] Instrumentation in runtime and gateway - [x] Prometheus metrics and histogram buckets - [x] Tracing tags and sampling adjustments - [x] Grafana dashboard JSON + templating - [x] Alert rule updates with runbook links - [x] Tests covering metrics aggregation and alerts - [x] Docs and console example updated

Testing: ran unit tests for metrics aggregation, end-to-end integration in perf-canary (small traffic canary run), and CI job (build/test/lint) passed after one flaky test rerun. Load validation: validated histogram bucket choices on a 48-hour production sampling window (sampled) and adjusted buckets to better capture short-generator tails.

Rollout and backward compatibility: instrumentation is additive; metrics exposed under new names (redwood_token_*). Grafana dashboards reference the new metrics but fall back gracefully when metrics are absent. Alerting changes are staged behind a feature flag and will be enabled for 10% of traffic initially, then rolled out to 100% after 48h of observation.

Risks and mitigations: increased metric cardinality — limited by aggregation tags (route, model_family, model_variant) and token_count bucketing to avoid high-series explosion. Tracing sampling adjusted to 1% for full traces and 10% for traces with token-latency > p95 to preserve tail visibility.

See related Linear: ENG-4820.

release_notes: Adds token-level Prometheus metrics, tracing tags for token_count/model_variant, Grafana dashboards for token cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alerts that reduce noise by using token-normalized tail latency. Backfill script included for recent histogram data.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag deploy/featureflags/ff-token-observability.yaml for staged rollout. Watch redwood_token_latency_p99_per_token and token-cardinality metrics for the first 48h. Run backfill script if you want historical histograms: scripts/migrations/backfill_token_histograms.py
